possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card provides only architecture, modality, and access type; no design, development, or evaluation details are reported for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not document training or tuning dataset details for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Without access to the training data, the types of explanations a model can provide are limited and more likely to be incorrect.
possible_risks.justification: No training data access or dataset information is provided in the card summary.

possible_risks.description: The content of the training data used for generating the model's output is not accessible.
possible_risks.justification: Because no training data content or provenance is documented, the content used to generate outputs is not accessible/traceable.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card lacks documentation of how data was collected, curated, and used to train the model.
